decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan using counterspells and removal spells while drawing cards to maintain card advantage. This Mono Blue Control deck focuses on stalling the game with counterspells like Force Spike and Mana Leak, while also utilizing cards like Parallax Tide and Chain of Vapor to control the board. The deck also includes some land destruction cards like Dust Bowl and Powder Keg to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the goal is to outlast the opponent and eventually win by either attacking with creature lands like Mishra's Factory or using card advantage to overpower them.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a lockdown with the Stasis enchantment, preventing opponents from untapping their lands and keeping them at a standstill. By combining it with cards like Forsaken City and Chain of Vapor, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additional cards like Black Vise and Ivory Tower provide alternate win conditions or ways to gain advantage while maintaining the Stasis lock. Counterspells and bounce spells help protect the combo and maintain control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Enchantress cards, such as Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence, to draw cards every time an enchantment is cast. The deck then aims to play a combination of enchantments like Opalescence and Parallax Wave to control the board and eventually win the game. The deck also includes cards like Replenish and Sterling Grove to retrieve key enchantments from the graveyard or to protect them. The mana base is built around Serra's Sanctum to generate a lot of mana to cast multiple enchantments in a turn.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with enchantment cards like Attunement and Parallax Wave, then using Replenish to bring them back onto the battlefield. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful enchantments like Opalescence to turn them into creatures and control the game with cards like Stifle and Mana Leak. The deck also includes ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing. The combination of graveyard recursion and enchantment synergy is key to this combo-heavy strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures, taking advantage of their low mana costs and synergy with each other. Using cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat in expensive creatures like Siege-Gang Commander, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace throughout the game while also having some control options with cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of red and green lands, as well as utility lands like Rishadan Port and Wasteland.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Replenish spell to bring back enchantments from the graveyard, such as Parallax Tide and Parallax Wave, to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes support cards like Abeyance and Seal of Cleansing to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing cards like Intuition to search for key pieces. The combination of enchantment recursion and board control allows for a powerful and synergistic strategy to win the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Replenish card to constantly bring back powerful enchantments such as Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide from the graveyard, creating a powerful board state and overwhelming the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Frantic Search and Attunement to help dig for combo pieces. Additionally, there are disruption cards like Swords to Plowshares and Stifle to handle opposing threats. The mana base is streamlined to support the combo and ensure consistency in executing the game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to cheat out a powerful creature with minimal effort. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Unmask while digging for key combo pieces with cards like Lim-Dûl's Vault and Portent. Once the combo is assembled, the deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn by utilizing cards like Shallow Grave and Sutured Ghoul. The deck aims for a fast and efficient win through a clever and unique combo strategy.

The deck focuses on aggressively controlling the board with efficient removal spells and disruptive hand disruption, while utilizing powerful threats like Exalted Angel, Nantuko Shade, and Hypnotic Specter to pressure the opponent quickly. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Phyrexian Arena to maintain a steady stream of resources. The land base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the "Full English Breakfast" combo, which involves using Hermit Druid to fill the graveyard with creatures, then using cards like Volrath's Shapeshifter to copy an activated ability like Triskelion's or Phyrexian Devourer's for a game-winning finish. The deck also includes necessary pieces for reanimation, disruption, and mana acceleration to support the combo. The goal is to quickly set up the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure a win.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes to disrupt your opponent's plans while slowly building up your own resources. The deck focuses on using cards like Standstill to generate card advantage and Parallax Tide to temporarily remove threats from the board. By controlling the game in this way, you can eventually overwhelm your opponent with powerful finishers like Decree of Justice or Faerie Conclave. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver your opponent until you can secure a victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the board using cards like Sphere of Resistance, Pyroclasm, and Thermokarst while also utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly summon powerful creatures like Terravore. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port, while also generating card advantage with Sylvan Library. With a mix of control elements and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm and outvalue the opponent while maintaining board presence and card advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly and efficiently filling the graveyard with enchantments using cards like Attunement and Intuition, before casting Replenish to bring them all back into play. Once the enchantments are back, cards like Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide can be used to control the board while turning them into creatures with Opalescence. Stifle and Chain of Vapor provide disruption for the opponent, while Impulse and Swords to Plowshares offer card selection and removal. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful enchantment-based combo.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent and finish the game as fast as possible. It includes efficient and hasty creatures like Mogg Fanatic, Jackal Pup, and Ball Lightning to apply pressure early on. The burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Incinerate, and Fireblast are used to both remove threats and deal direct damage to the opponent. Additionally, cards like Cursed Scroll and Sulfuric Vortex help to maintain pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck revolves around quickly getting Phyrexian Dreadnought onto the battlefield while using cards like Stifle, Counterspell, and Gush to protect the combo. Other cards like Opt and Impulse help with card selection and digging for combo pieces, while cards like Chain of Vapor provide additional disruption. The goal is to assemble the combo as quickly as possible and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures and control the board with cards like Winter Orb and Opposition. By utilizing creatures with powerful abilities like Mystic Snake and Deranged Hermit, along with mana dorks like Birds of Paradise, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The deck also includes a variety of removal options and ways to protect its creatures, making it a versatile and resilient control archetype in a premodern 1 vs 1 format.
